description_expanded: OverviewPRIVATE BEACH - Two Bikes - Newly renovated - 7 Palms 3The Space🏖 7 Palms – Renovated Condo with Private Beach Access!✨ QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:✔ PRIVATE Beach Access – Exclusive access just steps away✔ Newly Renovated & Gated Community – Updated finishes with added security✔ 2 FREE Adult Bikes Included – Cruise 30A with ease✔ Open-Concept Living Space – Bright, spacious living, dining, and kitchen area✔ Primary Suite with Private Balcony – King bed, ensuite bath & Gulf peek views✔ Guest Suite with King Bed – Comfortable and spacious for couples or guests✔ Outdoor Common Area with Green Space & Grills – Perfect for relaxing and cookouts✔ In-Unit Washer & Dryer – Easy beach-day cleanups✔ 2 Assigned Parking Spots – Stress-free parking✔ Free Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stream and stay connected✔ Professionally Managed – 24/7 support for peace of mind🏠 Welcome to 7 PalmsWelcome to 7 Palms — a beautifully renovated condo in a gated community with rare private beach access! Newly added to the rental market, this hidden gem offers comfort, convenience, and an unbeatable location along 30A.From the moment you enter the community gates, you’ll feel like you’ve arrived in your own coastal retreat. The private beach access is just a short walk from the back patio, making beach days effortless. Right outside the unit, you’ll find a large shared green space with grills, seating, and gathering areas — perfect for relaxing after a day in the sun.The ground level offers plenty of parking, an outdoor shower, and beach chairs for easy trips to the shore.Inside, the first floor features a bright, open living space with a fully equipped kitchen and dining area — ideal for spending time together. You’ll also find a washer and dryer and access to a spacious balcony overlooking the lush green space.Upstairs, two inviting bedrooms await. The primary suite includes a King bed, private bathroom, and balcony with Gulf views. The guest bedroom also features a King bed and easy access to a full shared bathroom, making this home perfect for couples or families.Whether you’re here to relax, explore, or soak up the sun, 7 Palms offers everything you need for an unforgettable beach getaway.🛏 SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4):Master Bedroom – King bed, private bathroomGuest Bedroom – King bed, shared bathroom📍 AREA ATTRACTIONS:This laid-back coastal community is ideal for a relaxing beach escape. Explore nearby Seacrest, where you’ll find scenic dune lakes, charming boutiques, and delicious dining options. Take peaceful walks along the sugar-white sand or enjoy sunset views along the shoreline.Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion is a local favorite, offering coffee shops, sweet treats, bike rentals, and live entertainment. With open green spaces and nearby nature trails, this area is perfect for guests who love both relaxation and adventure.Show less
